capabilities: Collect images referenced in the current note
Save collected images to a new folder
Run via command palette or right-click menu
extras: README links to the author's personal webpage (tdaykin.github.io) rather than hosting full documentation in the repository.
motivation: The author built it to convert school notes to LaTeX without handpicking images and to publish content to a GitHub Pages site with all associated images.
problem: Obsidian scatters a note's images across the attachments directory, so exporting or reusing them requires handpicking files one by one.
summary: Image collection tool that gathers all images referenced in the current note and saves them into a new folder.
